classification.difficultyReason: Evaluate both pieces at x=1 and compare, with graphs given. One part is continuous and one is not, as in p4-practice.

content.prompt: Decide whether these functions are continuous at $x=1$.

answer.worked:
Let $g(x)=x^2+2$ and $h(x)=5x-2$.
$$\begin{align*}g(1)&=1^2+2\\g(1)&=3\\h(1)&=5(1)-2\\h(1)&=3\end{align*}$$
The graphs join at $x=1$, so $f$ is continuous there.

Let $g(x)=2x+1$ and $h(x)=x^2+3$.
$$\begin{align*}g(1)&=2(1)+1\\g(1)&=3\\h(1)&=1^2+3\\h(1)&=4\end{align*}$$
The graphs do not join at $x=1$, so $f$ is discontinuous there.
